item.g:title: Mad About Monkeys (About Animals Series)
item.g:description: Owen Davey returns with a paperback edition of his illustrated, non-fiction, About Animals series. This time, exploring the marvellous world of monkeys! Did you know that that the mandrill monkey has fangs that are longer than a lions? Or that some monkeys have moustaches? And that monkeys and humans are believed to have shared a common ancestor around 25 to 30 million years ago? With over 250 species of monkey inhabiting our planet, there are so many things to discover about monkeys!

item.g:title: Crazy About Cats (About Animals Series)
item.g:description: Did you know that the fishing cat has partially webbed paws for catching fish? Or that pumas can leap up over 5 metres into trees? There are roughly 38 species of cats today, each one superbly adapted to their environment – whether that be in the rainforest or the desert! This captivating and stunningly illustrated guide will teach you everything you need to know about our feline friends.

item.g:title: JoJo & Gran Gran Collection
item.g:description: Introducing the delightful JoJo & Gran Gran book series, based on the beloved CBeebies television show. Join JoJo and her wise and loving grandmother, Gran Gran, on their heartwarming adventures in these six enchanting books: JoJo & Gran Gran Visit the Farm, Go to the Beach, Cook Together, Find a Dinosaur, Go to the Hairdresser, and See the Moon. With their charming storytelling and beautiful illustrations, these books are perfect for young readers eager to explore the world alongside JoJo and Gran Gran. For more CBeebies hits, check out our CBeebies bedtime stories collection. Title in This Set: Visit the Farm Go to the Beach Cook Together Find a Dinosaur Go to the Hairdresser See the Moon In Visit the Farm, young readers will accompany JoJo and Gran Gran on an exciting journey to the countryside. Together, they will meet adorable farm animals, learn about nature's wonders, and discover the joy of outdoor exploration. This book not only entertains children but also teaches them about farm life and the importance of appreciating the natural world around them. In Go to the Beach, JoJo and Gran Gran embark on a fun-filled day by the seaside. From building sandcastles to collecting seashells, this book captures the magic of a beach adventure. Through colourful illustrations and engaging narratives, children will learn about coastal habitats, tides, and the beauty of the ocean. It's a perfect book to spark a child's imagination and ignite their love for the beach. Cook Together invites young readers to join JoJo and Gran Gran in the kitchen for a cooking extravaganza. As they prepare delicious meals and treats, children will discover the joy of teamwork, following recipes, and exploring new flavours. This book encourages a love for cooking and empowers children to become confident little chefs. In Find a Dinosaur, JoJo and Gran Gran embark on an exciting paleontological adventure. They search for hidden dinosaur fossils, learning fascinating facts about these ancient creatures along the way. This book not only sparks a child's curiosity about dinosaurs but also teaches them about the wonders of science and exploration. Go to the Hairdresser takes readers on a delightful trip to the hair salon with JoJo and Gran Gran. Through vivid illustrations and relatable storytelling, children will discover the importance of self-care, grooming, and personal style. This book promotes self-expression and empowers young readers to embrace their uniqueness. In the final book, See the Moon, JoJo and Gran Gran embark on a nighttime journey to witness the magic of the moon. From stargazing to learning about lunar phases, this book introduces young readers to the wonders of astronomy. It instils a sense of wonder and curiosity about the universe, fostering a love for science and exploration. With the JoJo & Gran Gran book series, children will not only be entertained but also educated. The stories promote important values such as family bonds, friendship, exploration, and learning. The vibrant illustrations bring the characters and settings to life, immersing readers in JoJo and Gran Gran's world. These books are perfect for children aged 3 to 5 and make excellent additions to any home, library, or classroom. They encourage early literacy skills, vocabulary development, and imaginative play. Whether enjoyed independently or read aloud with loved ones, the JoJo & Gran Gran book series is a delightful and educational journey that children will cherish for years to come. So, join JoJo and Gran Gran on their wonderful adventures and let these heartwarming books inspire and entertain young readers as they discover the joys of family, exploration, and the world around them. From the publisher: Visit the Farm In this story, JoJo is excited to show Gran Gran around the city farm - it's been a few months since she was last there, and she can't wait to see Melanie the chick again. But when they arrive at the chicken enclosure, they can't find the little fluffy chick - where could she be? Go to the Beach JoJo and Gran Gran are taking a trip to the beach to build a sandcastle. But when JoJo's sandcastle gets trodden on, she feels sad. Can Gran Gran show JoJo that even if their sandcastle doesn't last forever, making memories together is what matters most? Cook Together JoJo & Gran Gran are going to cook one of Great Gran Gran's special St Lucian recipes! But when the shop is closed, what will they do to get the ingredients they need? It's time for a Gran Gran Plan! Find a Dinosaur JoJo loves to play with her toy dinosaurs in Gran Gran's garden. Today, JoJo and Gran Gran go the museum to find a T Rex skeleton and learn more about dinosaurs, but the museum is very big and they get lost! It's time for a Gran Gran Plan . . . Go to the Hairdresser JoJo goes to the hairdresser for the first time ever with Gran Gran, and learns all about how much fun it can be to help out. She even has her hair done, too! See the Moon JoJo and Gran Gran are having a sleepover! JoJo notices that the moon is a funny shape, so Gran Gran explains why. Featuring favourite characters from the hit CBeebies show, this book is perfect for sharing with little JoJo & Gran Gran fans.

item.g:title: Filthy Rich Vampires Series (Book 2-4)
item.g:description: Titles in this Set: 1. Filthy Rich Vampires: Second Rite (Book 2) 2. Filthy Rich Vampires: Three Queens (Book 3) 3. Filthy Rich Vampires: For Eternity (Book 4) Description: Filthy Rich Vampires: Second Rite (Book 2) Thea Melbourne has a broken heart. A month after her world turned upside down, she's struggling to return to the life she left behind. Her mother is in a coma, she's selling off designer gowns to pay the bills, and her roommates seem to think she's made of glass. But when the vampire who broke her heart shows up at the hospital, she learns a devastating secret. To save the love of his life, Julian pushed her away. Now he has to live with the pain and regret or find someone to put him out of his misery. When it becomes clear that Thea is still in danger, he has a choice to make. He can stay away like the Council demands or risk everything, including their lives, to win her back. Convincing her means facing his own dark secrets and resisting the temptation to claim her as his mate once and for all. But Thea isn't going to make that easy for him. Filthy Rich Vampires: Three Queens (Book 3) All magic will die, and with it, all who carry it. Every last one of us . . . Thea and Julian have made their choice, but can they survive the fallout? Returning to the world of the vampire elite as Solstice falls, they must navigate new dangers, treacherous allies, and morally grey friendships. The past might hold the key to their future, but to find out, Julian must face the monster he was once, and as forgotten magic stirs in Thea's blood, the search for answers leads to devastating consequences. With the future of the magical world hanging in the balance, tensions rising in their family, and war looming on the horizon, will their love triumph, or will they pay the ultimate price? Filthy Rich Vampires: For Eternity (Book 4) Magic has awoken. As Thea takes her place as Queen with Julian by her side, their world splinters. A new game of deceit begins between factions vying for control. Power is the prize, and Thea and Julian are caught in the middle of it. Targeted by the Vampire Council, the Mordicum, and their families, they soon discover an even deadlier threat to their future. Someone killed the Queen whose throne Thea now reigns on, and time is running out to find the killer before they get to Thea.

item.g:title: Read with Spot Collection
item.g:description: Title in This Set: 1. Happy Birthday, Spot! 2. Spot and his Grandma 3. Spot's New Game 4. Spot's Garden 5. Spot's Camping Trip 6. Spot's Tummy Ache 7. Spot's Show-and-Tell 8. Time For Bed, Spot Description: Happy Birthday, Spot! It's Spot's birthday. He helps Sally to make a cake and Sam to prepare the garden. But there is a special surprise for Spot - what will it be? Spot and his Grandma Spot loves Grandma, and Grandma loves Spot. When Spot's mum and dad go out for the day, his grandma comes to stay. What games will they play? Spot's New Game Spot and his friend are playing hide-and-seek. Spot starts to count, "One, two, three..." Where can his friends be hiding? Spot's Garden Spot loves to help his grandpa plat seeds in the garden. But the birds also like to eat them! Find out how Spot and his grandpa find a way to grow things and feed the birds. Spot's Camping Trip Spot and his friends want to go camping together, but it just won't stop raining outside. So the three friends find a fun way to entertain themselves at home! Spot's Tummy Ache Spot is feeling unwell. Luckily, he does not feel ill for very long. When he hears his friends playing outside, Spot starts to feel better. Spot's Show-and-Tell Spot and his friends love show-and-tell at school. Helen and Tom both have something special to show the class, but what will Spot and Steve bring? Time For Bed, Spot "Time for bed, Spot" calls Mum. But Spot isn't ready for bed yet. He wants to play with his toys instead. Will anything make Spot feel sleepy?

item.g:title: Filthy Rich Vampires: Three Queens
item.g:description: As the Winter Solstice falls, Thea Melbourne and Julian Rousseaux return to the social season. Now, with their bond at its strongest - and most irresistibly intense - they face new deadly tests as the vampire elite will stop at nothing to tear them apart. Until Thea receives devastating news that leads them to the ancient, winding streets of Venice, where Julian's past beckons - along with the monster he once was. As forgotten magic stirs in Thea's blood, Julian has no choice but to confront his demons, or he risks losing Thea forever. Because peril dances in the shadows as a deadly threat rises. One that could shatter their world, their families, and even each other ... unless they're willing to pay the price.

item.g:title: Skandar and the Spirit War (Skandar Series Book 5)
item.g:description: Skandar is in hiding after the Chaos Cup where Rex Manning revealed a game-changing secret. But as Rex prepares to invade the Mainland, the Islanders are not sure who to trust. With one of Skandar’s closest friends now fighting for the enemy, Skandar must build new alliances – including an uneasy truce with Kenna. To defeat Rex, Skandar and his friends will need to look back to the origins of the Island, and harness the full power of their elemental magic. Can Skandar become the leader he needs to be – to save the Mainland and the heart of the Island itself? Get ready for unlikely heroes, elemental magic, sky battles, ancient secrets and ferocious unicorns in this highly anticipated adventure that will keep you reading after lights out!

item.g:title: Die with Zero: Getting All You Can from Your Money and Your Life
item.g:description: A common-sense guide to living rich . . . instead of dying rich Imagine if by the time you died, you did everything you were told to. You worked hard, saved your money, and looked forward to financial freedom when you retired. The only thing you wasted along the way was . . . your life. Die with Zero presents a startling new and provocative philosophy as well as practical guide on how to get the most out of your money—and out of your life. It’s intended for those who place lifelong memorable experiences far ahead of simply making and accumulating money for one’s so-called “golden years.” In short, Bill Perkins wants to rescue you from over-saving and under-living. Regardless of your age, Die with Zero will teach you Perkins’s plan for optimizing your life, stage by stage, so you’re fully engaged and enjoying what you’ve worked and saved for. You’ll discover how to maximize your lifetime memorable moments with “time-bucketing,” how to convert your earnings into priceless memories by following your “net worth curve,” and how to navigate decisions about whether to invest in, or delay, a meaningful adventure with your “fulfillment curve” and “personal interest rate.” Using his own life experiences as well as the inspiring stories and cautionary tales of others—and drawing on eye-opening insights about time, money, and happiness from psychological science and behavioral finance—Perkins makes a timely, convincing, and contrarian case for living large.

item.g:title: Sex at Dawn: How We Mate, Why We Stray, and What It Means for Modern Relationships
item.g:description: In this controversial, thought-provoking, and brilliant book, renegade thinkers Christopher Ryan and Cacilda Jethá debunk almost everything we “know” about sex, weaving together convergent, frequently overlooked evidence from anthropology, archaeology, primatology, anatomy, and psychosexuality to show how far from human nature monogamy really is. In Sex at Dawn, the authors expose the ancient roots of human sexuality while pointing toward a more optimistic future illuminated by our innate capacities for love, cooperation, and generosity.

item.g:title: Recipes from the World of Tolkien
item.g:description: The perfect Christmas gifting idea for Tolkien fans, offering a delightful collection of culinary inspiration in a beautifully crafted hardback. Ever wondered what Lembas Bread, Cram, or Beorn's Honey Cakes might taste like? From Crickhollow Apple Loaf, Pippin's Minas Tirith Lunch, and Brandywine Fish Pie to Dwarven Spiced Pickled Beetroot, Westfarthing Fairings, and Beorn's Twice-Baked Cakes, Recipes from the World of Tolkien includes over 75 mouth-watering recipes that will take you on a journey through Middle-earth, delivering a treat for your taste buds and your imagination. Immerse yourself in Tolkien's epic fantasy world with recipes inspired by its places and characters. Whether it's breakfast or second breakfast, elevenses or afternoon tea, lunch or dinner - cook up a feast fit for orcs and elves alike. This collection of delicious recipes also features stunning illustrations and artwork throughout, as well as short feature essays that explore the compelling role of food in Tolkien's works. This is the perfect, must-have addition to any Tolkien fan's bookshelf. Whether it’s kids' books or cookbooks, we stock an extensive range of literature for you to get your hands on. Shop now!

item.g:title: The Art of Impossible: A Peak Performance Primer
item.g:description: What does it take to accomplish the impossible? What does it take to shatter our limitations, exceed our expectations, and turn our greatest hopes into our most recent achievements?Bestselling author and peak-performance expert Steven Kotler decodes the secrets of elite performers—athletes, artists, scientists, CEOs, and others—who have changed our definition of the possible, teaching us how we, too, can stretch far beyond our capabilities and make impossible dreams much more attainable.We are capable of so much more than we know—that’s the message at the core of The Art of Impossible, a life-changing experience disguised as a how-to manual for peak performance. Building upon cutting-edge neuroscience and more than twenty years of research, Steven Kotler lays out the blueprint for extreme performance improvement. If you want to aim high, here is the playbook!

item.g:title: The Big Leap: Conquer Your Hidden Fear and Take Life to the Next Level
item.g:description: Remove the Last Obstacle to Ultimate Success In The Big Leap, New York Times bestselling author Gay Hendricks reveals a simple yet comprehensive program for overcoming our one barrier to happiness and fulfillment, providing a clear path for achieving our true potential and attaining not only financial success but also success in love and life.

item.g:title: What Every BODY is Saying: An Ex-FBI Agent's Guide to Speed-Reading People
item.g:description: Joe Navarro, a former counterintelligence officer specializing in behavioral analysis, presents the definitive book on how to best utilize nonverbal communication for success in business and life. He says that's his best offer. Is it? She says she agrees. Does she? The interview went great—or did it? He said he'd never do it again. But he did. Read this book and send your nonverbal intelligence soaring. Joe Navarro, a former FBI counterintelligence officer and a recognized expert on nonverbal behavior, explains how to "speed-read" people: decode sentiments and behaviors, avoid hidden pitfalls, and look for deceptive behaviors. You'll also learn how your body language can influence what your boss, family, friends, and strangers think of you. You will discover: The ancient survival instincts that drive body languageWhy the face is the least likely place to gauge a person's true feelingsWhat thumbs, feet, and eyelids reveal about moods and motivesThe most powerful behaviors that reveal our confidence and true sentiments Simple nonverbals that instantly establish trustSimple nonverbals that instantly communicate authority Filled with examples from Navarro's professional experience, this definitive book offers a powerful new way to navigate your world.

item.g:title: You Choose Series
item.g:description: The You Choose Series is a set of children's books by Pippa Goodhart and Nick Sharratt. The books are interactive and allow children to make decisions about what happens next in the story. There are several books in the series, each with its own unique storyline and set of choices. The books are designed for children aged between 3 and 7 years old, and they are a great way to get children engaged in reading. The interactive nature of the books makes them fun and engaging, and they are perfect for children who are just starting to read on their own. Titles in This Set: 1. You Choose 2. You Choose in Space 3. You Choose Your Dreams 4. You Choose Fairy Tales 5. You Choose Christmas The books in this set include You Choose, You Choose in Space, You Choose Fairy Tales, You Choose Your Dreams and You Choose Christmas. Each book has its own set of choices that children can make, allowing them to explore different storylines and outcomes. Overall, the You Choose Series is a fun and engaging set of books that are perfect for children who love to make decisions and explore different outcomes. The books are interactive and encourage children to use their imagination, making them an excellent tool for developing literacy skills. The illustrations in the books are bright and colourful, and they help to bring the stories to life. The books also feature simple text that is easy for children to read on their own, making them perfect for early readers. One of the great things about the You Choose Series is that children can read the books over and over again, making different choices each time. This means that the books have a high replay value, and children can continue to enjoy them for years to come. In addition to being fun and engaging, the You Choose Series also has educational value. The books encourage children to think critically and make decisions, helping to develop their problem-solving skills. They also introduce children to different concepts and ideas, such as space travel, fairy tales, and the natural world. Overall, the You Choose Series is an excellent set of books for children who love to read and make decisions. The books are fun, engaging, and educational, and they are sure to become a favourite among children and parents alike. About the Authors: Pippa Goodhart is a British author of children's books. She was born in Leicester, England, in 1945 and studied English Literature at St. Anne's College, Oxford. After graduating, she worked as a teacher, a lecturer, and a writer. Goodhart has written over 100 children's books, including picture books, early readers, and young adult fiction. Her books have been published in many languages and have won numerous awards, including the Nestle Smarties Book Prize. Goodhart's writing is known for its warmth, humour, and sensitivity. She has a gift for creating characters that children can relate to and stories that are both engaging and thought-provoking. Goodhart is also a strong advocate for children's literacy and has been involved in many initiatives aimed at promoting reading and writing skills among young people. She has worked with organizations such as the National Literacy Trust and the Society of Authors to promote literacy and support aspiring writers. In addition to her writing and advocacy work, Goodhart is also a regular speaker at literary festivals and other events. She is known for her engaging and entertaining presentations, which often include readings from her books and interactive activities for children. Pippa Goodhart is a talented and influential author who has made a significant contribution to the world of children's literature. Her books have brought joy and inspiration to countless young readers, and her advocacy work has helped to promote literacy and support aspiring writers. Nick Sharratt is a British illustrator and author who is known for his distinctive and colourful illustrations. He was born in London in 1962 and studied graphic design at St Martin's School of Art. Sharratt has illustrated over 250 books, including works by Jacqueline Wilson, Julia Donaldson, and Michael Rosen. He is also the author of several picture books, including the popular Shark in the Park series. Sharratt's illustrations are known for their bold colours and playful style, which make them appealing to children of all ages. He has won numerous awards for his work, including the Children's Book Award and the Red House Children's Book Award. Nick Sharratt is a highly regarded illustrator and author whose work has brought joy and inspiration to countless young readers. Description: You Choose Imagine you could go anywhere, meet anyone and do anything. Where would you live? Where would you sleep? Who would be your friends? What games would you play? Go on . . . you choose! You Choose in Space Zoom off into space for an adventure where YOU CHOOSE what happens next. Which alien would you most like to be friends with? And what fantastically freaky food will you decide to munch for lunch? You Choose Your Dreams What would it be like to be as little as a mouse; or as big as a house? Imagine exploring the depths of the ocean, travelling into the past or the future - YOU CHOOSE YOUR DREAMS and your own wild and wonderful adventure! You Choose Fairy Tales Welcome to your fairy tale where YOU CHOOSE your own once-upon-a-time adventure... Which favourite fairy-tale character will you choose to be? And where will you go on your fairy-tale quest-perhaps a royal palace, or the seven seas, or the deep dark woods? You Choose Christmas Make up your own Christmas adventure where YOU CHOOSE what happens. Which Christmas jumper would you like to wear? Which job would you choose to do in Santa's workshop? Where would you like to sleep on Christmas Eve?

item.g:title: Mr. Men and Little Miss Collection
item.g:description: Title in This Set: 1. Mr. Tickle 2. Mr Men Little Miss Vets 3. Mr. Men Little Miss The Easter Bunny Description: Mr. Tickle Enjoy the story that first introduced the Mr Men to the world in this special 50th anniversary edition!Mr Tickle is small and round and has arms that stretch and stretch. Extraordinarily long arms, perfect for tickling!In 1971 Mr Tickle was published, bringing fun, tickles and laughter to children everywhere. Now, 50 years later you can enjoy this special upsized edition of the classic story with a bonus new story about how it all began. The perfect gift for fans of the Mr Men.The Mr Men and Little Miss have been delighting children for generations with their charming and funny antics. Bold illustrations and funny stories make Mr Men and Little Miss the perfect story time experience for children aged two up. Have you met them all? Mr Men Little Miss Vets Join the Mr Men and Little Miss as they go to work at a Vets!Little Miss Brainy and Mr Quiet look after lots of different animals at the Mr. Men and Little Miss Vets. You may have met some pets just like them yourselves, but there are certainly some you won’t have! Who will visit the Vets today? Mr. Men Little Miss The Easter Bunny This new Mr Men and Little Miss story is the perfect gift this Easter.Have you ever met the Easter Bunny? Little Miss Tiny has and she knows exactly how he creates the right egg for the right person, but you’ll have to read the story to find out! Get ready for a spring tale with surprises galore and lots of chocolate.

item.g:title: Priest Series (Sprayed Edges)
item.g:description: Titles In The Set: 1. Priest 2. Sinner 3. Saint 4. Midnight Mass (Midnight Mass is a novella and a sequel to Priest) Description: Priest He's a priest, and here is his confession. There are many rules a priest can't break. A priest cannot marry. A priest cannot abandon his flock. A priest cannot forsake his God. Tyler Bell has had no problem playing by the rules for the last three years after a family tragedy set him on the path to priesthood. That all changes when the delicious, sultry voice of Poppy Danforth sinks its claws in him through the screen of his confessional booth, and he can't get her sins out of his head. It should be easy to put his impure thoughts of her to rest, considering the vows Tyler has taken. It should be nothing to overcome what the sight and sound of her does to him, when his life with the Church means everything. But once he has his first forbidden taste of those red lips, Tyler can't help but break all his rules for Poppy-no matter what it might cost them both. Sinner He leads a life of sin, and she's committed to a life of virtue. Sean Bell is not a good man, and he's never pretended to be. He doesn't believe in goodness, God, or any happy ending that isn't paid for in advance. There are words for men like him: playboy. Womanizer. Skirt-chaser. Sinner. When he meets a gorgeous college girl at a fundraiser, he has no problem telling her exactly what filthy things he wants to do to her until he realizes she's his best friend's little sister, Zenobia "Zenny" Iverson, all grown up. Worse than that...she's also about to become a nun. Zenny, though, isn't looking to play it safe during her final month of freedom. She wants to make sure choosing God is the right path, and to do that, she propositions Sean to show her every carnal temptation she's leaving behind. Unable to refuse, Sean finds himself falling for her, body and soul, and questioning not just the morals he's dodged for years, but his relationship with the God Zenny has pledged herself to. The only problem is...what if Sean wants Zenny to choose him instead of Him? Saint It would take a saint to resist Elijah Iverson. Aiden was the last person in the world anyone expected to become a monk. But the decision to become a monk saved his life, and he's determined to do it right, even if it's taken him from his millionaire party-boy lifestyle...and the love of his life, Elijah Iverson. Four-plus years haven't made letting Elijah go any easier, but at least Aiden hasn't had to come face-to-face with those whiskey eyes and soft mouths since he left. That is, until Elijah shows up on his doorstep, assigned to accompany Aiden on a European monastery road trip for an article he's writing. The pull is still there between them, but Aiden knows he can't have Elijah back. He broke his heart when he left, and now Elijah's engaged to someone else. Aiden chose God. He chose his vows. Except, between whispered confessions and stolen kisses and moments bent over an ancient altar, those vows are feeling flimsier by the day. Vows or not, it would take a saint to resist Elijah...and Aiden's sure as hell no saint. Midnight Mass We are told that God will punish the wicked. That sinful men will reap what they sow. We are told to scourge our souls with prayer and pain to become clean once again. Well, here I am. Wicked and sinful. Desperate to become clean…even though it feels so good to be dirty. But even I never expected what came next. Even I never expected my punishment to come so soon. Midnight Mass is a novella and a sequel to Priest. It's intended for mature audiences only.

item.g:title: World's Worst Children
item.g:description: Titles In The Set: 1. The World’s Worst Children 1 2. The World’s Worst Children 2 3. The World’s Worst Children 3 4. The World’s Worst Superheroes (Hardback) Description: The World’s Worst Children 1 Ten cautionary tales and a delightfully dreadful cast of characters from number one bestselling author David Walliams! Are you ready to meet the world’s worst children? Five beastly boys and five gruesome girls! Like Sofia Sofa, a TV superfan so stuck to the sofa that she’s turning into one! And Blubbering Bertha, a bawling big sister with a horrid habit of telling tales! The World’s Worst Children 2 The brilliant follow-up to the bestselling The World’s Worst Children! Ten more stories about hilariously horrible kids! Do you dare to meet the worst children in the world? Be warned! Inside are five ghastly girls and five badder-than-bad boys! Like Humbert the hungry baby, who literally eats his parents out of house and home. And Gruesome Griselda who likes to play tricks on everyone with her vast collection of creepy-crawlies. The World’s Worst Children 3 Look out! It’s more badly behaved boys and ghoulish girls! Like Boastful Barnabas who is so big-headed he might just explode! And Tandy and her titanic tantrums and who will be crowned bully of the year! From number one bestselling author David Walliams come ten more hilarious and horrendous tales, illustrated throughout by artistic genius Tony Ross. The World’s Worst Superheroes (Hardback) When is the queen not just the queen? When she is WONDERQUEEN! KAPOW! Is that an especially large bird? Is it a weirdly small plane? No: it’s THUNDERHOUND! BLAM! When her schoolteachers turn into deadly dinosaurs, who can possibly stop them? Why, DINO-KID, of course! ROAR!

item.g:title: Nancy Birtwhistle Green Gardening
item.g:description: Titles In This Set: 1. Clean & Green 2. The Green Gardening Handbook (Hardback) 3. Green Living Made Easy Description: Clean & Green Simple swaps and innovative ideas for cleaning and maintaining your home that won't cost the Earth.Learn how easy it is to make simple swaps in your cleaning and tidying methods for a more eco-friendly home, with helpful tips from bestselling author and Great British Bake Off winner Nancy Birtwhistle.This beautifully illustrated black and white guide with 101 hints and sustainable, natural cleaning tips and hacks will help you take small steps that have a massive positive environmental impact. In Clean & Green, Nancy shares the simple recipes and methods she has developed since making a conscious effort to live more sustainably, many of which are faster and easier than the go-to products and methods most of us use now.From everyday cleaning and laundry tips to zero-effort oven cleaner and guidance on removing tricky stains from clothing and furniture, these economical, practical methods are perfect for anyone looking to reduce their use of plastic and throwaway products. Nancy shares her tried-and-tested recipes for all-purpose cleaners, replacements for harmful chemicals that will keep both your home and the planet clean and green for future generations. The Green Gardening Handbook (Hardback) Going green in the garden has never been easier with Nancy Birtwhistle’s sustainable, eco-friendly tips that will help you make the most of your space, and what it can grow. Whether you have a sprawling garden, a modest patch of grass or just a spare windowsill, The Green Gardening Handbook has over 100 tips that will help you embrace the joy of growing and eating from your own garden. Green Living Made Easy One change, any change, will make a difference to our precious planet. We all want to do our best for our homes and the planet, but it’s often hard to find the time and energy to think of alternatives. Nancy Birtwhistle makes it easy with 101 indispensable tips, ideas and recipes that will help you to live a more eco-friendly life without giving up on any home comforts.This practical book is the ultimate guide to reducing your environmental impact while saving you time and money. Inside are tips and home hacks on everything from eco cleaning, upcycling and making the most out of your weekly shop to small-space gardening and creative crafts, plus a selection of Nancy's delicious recipes. Clearly explained, accessible and beautifully illustrated with black and white line-drawings, Green Living Made Easy is the perfect guide for anyone looking to pursue a more sustainable lifestyle but unsure where to start.

item.g:title: The Greatest Football Stars (Vol 1-2)
item.g:description: Greatest Football Stars dives into the incredible journeys of the world’s greatest players of all time. Featuring talents from all around the globe, this series covers their unique journeys to stardom – from playing football in the park to performing in front of capacity crowds on the biggest stage and in the biggest leagues. Titles in this Set: The Greatest Football Stars (Volume 1) 1. Cristiano Ronaldo 2. Lionel Messi 3. Diego Maradona 4. David Beckham 5. Pelé 6. Ronaldinho Gaúcho 7. Peter Schmeichel 8. George Best 9. Bobby Charlton 10. Bobby Moore The Greatest Football Stars (Volume 2) 1. Harry Kane 2. Neymar 3. Kevin De Bruyne 4. Mohamed Salah 5. Rodri 6. Thierry Henry 7. Son Heung-Min 8. Bruno Fernandes 9. Robert Lewandowski 10. Virgil Van Dijk Description: The Greatest Football Stars (Volume 1) Cristiano Ronaldo Cristiano Ronaldo is one of the greatest players of all time. After proving himself under Sir Alex Ferguson at Manchester United, he earned a mighty reputation at Real Madrid and helped them strengthen their game. His talent and unmatched ability took the footballing world by storm. Becoming one of the world’s favourite players, his journey to the top of the game was full of hard work, goals and confidence. Lionel Messi Lionel Messi’s rapid rise to stardom was filled with hardship, determination, bravery and over 800 goals. It’s almost impossible to believe that this Argentinian giant of football was once considered too small to play. Proving any doubters wrong, he showed the world just how talented he was and took both club and country to new, victorious heights. If Messi is on a team, there just is no stopping them. Diego Maradona Diego Maradona is best known for his famous ‘Hand of God’ goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final against England, but there is so much more to his story. His iconic career spanned twenty-one years and included many disappointing lows and unbeatable highs. His skill was almost effortless, and the impact he had on games was unlike any other player. David Beckham David Beckham’s footballing career was one of iconic moments and interesting haircuts. From being Manchester United’s golden boy to an international sensation, this beloved English footballer was unlike any other player. Earning respect from fans all around the world for his unique skills, his popularity was unmatched. After all, nobody can bend it like Beckham. Pelé Edson Arantes do Nascimento, better known as Pelé, was from humble beginnings – living in poverty in São Paulo and taught to play football by his beloved father. Throughout his career, Pelé scored over 1,000 incredible goals, won the World Cup three times and inspired thousands to play the beautiful game. As an accurate and powerful player, he took football to new and extraordinary heights. Ronaldinho Gaúcho Ronaldinho Gaúcho is a champion of Brazilian football. Forever following his father’s advice, he always played with happiness and freedom – he just played with the ball. He saved Barcelona when the club was down on its luck, bringing light and luck back to their side. Winning many titles and awards over his career, including the 2002 World Cup, Ronaldinho secured his legacy as one of the greats of the game. Peter Schmeichel Peter Schmeichel was a giant of goalkeeping – standing at an enormous six foot four! When he was in goal, nothing got past him. He tried things nobody had done before, and his attitude and ideas have influenced the way goalkeepers play today. He was Manchester United’s star shot-stopper for many years, and he played a huge role in Denmark’s 1992 Euros victory. George Best George Best was as good as his name. After being discovered when he was just fifteen, he went on to play for Manchester United for thirteen years. Known for his excellent dribbling skills and fashionable style, he became a huge celebrity on and off the pitch. Even Pelé said that George was the greatest footballer he’d ever seen. Bobby Charlton Bobby Charlton was an important player in England’s winning 1966 World Cup squad. He scored an incredible forty-nine goals for his country in 106 appearances. As well as being an international sensation, he was also a Manchester United hero and helped the club rebuild and improve after a devastating tragedy that threatened to shut them down. A true legend, he is one of the best English players in history. Bobby Moore Bobby Moore’s huge legacy is unlike any other. He was West Ham United’s greatest player of all time and an icon of the game. Described as the perfect leader, he also went on to captain the England team to victory in the 1966 World Cup. Loved and respected by all football fans to this day, he was a star of the game. Feature Specification Author Luke Paton Publisher Sweet Cherry Publishing Books Included Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Diego Maradona, David Beckham, Pelé, Ronaldinho Gaúcho, Peter Schmeichel, George Best, Bobby Charlton, Bobby Moore Total Books 10 Paperbacks (Foundational Legends Set) Target Age Range Ages 7 and above (Key Stage 2) Genre Children's Non-Fiction / Sports Biography / Literacy Core Themes Hard Work, Integrity, Overcoming Adversity, Global History 2026 Context Peak relevance ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 next month The Greatest Football Stars (Volume 2) Harry Kane Nothing can stop Harry Kane from scoring once he gets the ball. He’s a superstar striker no matter where he plays, from Tottenham Hotspur to Bayern Munich to England’s national team. Harry’s already England’s top goalscorer of all-time, but he still wants more! Neymar From Santos to Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain, Neymar is a star wherever he plays. He’s also one of Brazil’s best, determined to help his national team succeed – no matter what. He even scored the winning goal that made them Olympic champions for the first time. Follow his rise to the top! Kevin De Bruyne Kevin De Bruyne is a superstar player for club and country. His leadership qualities and unmatched skill with the ball makes him a midfielder to be reckoned with. After a successful run with Manchester City, he’s now starting a new adventure with Napoli. Mohamed Salah Mo Salah is an inspirational goalscorer who has helped Liverpool achieve victory after victory. He’s won almost everything there is to win, both for his team and as a player. He’s competed all over the world, causing trouble for defenders all over the pitch. Rodri Rodri is a treble winner with Manchester City and a Euros champion with Spain. His passing and playmaking abilities in midfield make him one of the greatest players in the game, and his determination to succeed is unmatched. Sometimes it seems he can do anything! Thierry Henry Thierry Henry is an Arsenal legend. He spent eight years with the club and became their all-time top goalscorer with 228 goals! His pace and strength made him unlike any other player. He was also a star player for France, exciting crowds all around the world. Son Heung-Min Son Heung-min is one of Tottenham Hotspurs’ greatest players ever. He was part of the squad who broke the club’s seventeen-year trophyless curse, helping them claim victory in the Europa League. His attacking talent is unlike anyone else’s, and his presence in front of goal is magical. Bruno Fernandes Bruno Fernandes is a star for club and country, putting on showstopping performances and scoring when it counts. It’s hard to imagine the Manchester United or Portugal teams without him. His dynamic style and playmaking ability make him a midfielder unlike any other. Robert Lewandowski Robert Lewandowski is a shooting star! When he was young, Robert believed that he was destined to become a world-class footballer – and he did just that! His goalscoring record is every striker’s dream, making him a legend of the game. Virgil Van Dijk Nothing gets past Virgil van Dijk! As captain of club and country, Virgil’s passion for the game shines through in every match. His leadership has taken Liverpool to Premier League glory, and has cemented Virgil as one of the finest defenders of his generation. Feature Specification Author Luke Paton Publisher Sweet Cherry Publishing Books Included Harry Kane, Neymar, Kevin De Bruyne, Mohamed Salah, Rodri, Thierry Henry, Son Heung-Min, Bruno Fernandes, Robert Lewandowski, Virgil Van Dijk Total Books 10 Paperbacks (Volume 2 Box Set) Target Age Range Ages 7 to 9 (Key Stage 2) Genre Children's Non-Fiction / Sports Biography / Education Publication Date May 2026 2026 Context Released perfectly ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 next month Luke Paton is an experienced children's author and scriptwriter with a stellar track record of producing engaging content for magazines, comic strips, and books.
